# State Management Checklist: GitHub Pilot Issue Ingest and Eligibility

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-009C1 requirements and plan artifacts clearly bound pilot eligibility state to current GitHub/task projection data, avoid introducing claim/dispatch/runner/sandbox/remediation state, and separate manual smoke evidence from future automation and evidence surfaces.
**Created**: 2026-05-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are pilot eligibility state requirements fully derived from current GitHub issue identity, labels, linked-PR state, terminal status, duplicate task presence, and current Mission Control task projection data? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §Pilot GitHub Issue, Data Model §Eligibility Decision]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the exact task fields for proving one GitHub-linked pilot root task documented, including workspace, repository, issue number, sync timestamp, and root-task identity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Sync Identity Proof]
- [ ] CHK003 Are duplicate-prevention state requirements complete enough to keep repeated GitHub ingest/sync at exactly one pilot root task for the same issue identity? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-009, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Are local-only task state requirements complete enough to preserve non-pilot local tasks while excluding them from pilot eligibility and pilot source-of-truth evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §FR-010, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK005 Are side-effect absence requirements complete across current schema surfaces for child tasks, task-chain lineage, dispatch attempts, assignment, runs, dispositions, artifacts, and dispatch/pipeline/remediation activities? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Pilot Root Task, Contract §Side-Effect Snapshot]
- [ ] CHK006 Are future claim, runner, and sandbox surfaces constrained to table-if-exists checks without requiring placeholder schema or lifecycle state in SPEC-009C1? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Assumptions, Contract §Side-Effect Snapshot]

## Requirement Clarity
